description: Permanently delete a resource this machine published, with the qURL CLI. This cannot be undone: existing links stop working, the CRID can never be shared again, and publishing the same target later makes a different CRID. Confirm with the user first, and prefer set_crid_sharing with stop, which is reversible. Deleting a resource that is already deleted succeeds with already_gone true.

crid.description: The CRID of the resource to delete permanently. Copy it exactly; never trim or change case.

name: delete_crid
title: Delete a CRID permanently
